name: Mashiro Summer
source:
Many years ago, it snowed even in summer. It was said that the snowfall can grant wishes, so the townspeople made lots of wishes and prayers. As time passed, everyone gradually forgot about that strange summer. Keiji is a normal student who wanted a peaceful school life, but he is surrounded by troublesome girls: his cousin Chihiro who’s only good at housework and nothing else, sports freak Aki, poor ojousama Sakino, Mio who always seems to get herself wet and do-M stalker Kaho.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/11/01/november-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
多年前，即使盛夏也曾降下白雪。據說那場雪能夠實現願望，鎮民因此許下了無數心願與祈禱。隨著時間流逝，所有人都漸漸忘記那個奇異夏天。

結城將孝是一名只想平靜度過校園生活的普通學生，身邊卻圍著一群麻煩女孩：除了家務什麼都不會的表親八坂千尋、運動狂片瀨亞季、生活貧困的大小姐天城咲乃、總把自己弄得溼漉漉的美崎澪，以及超級受虐狂兼跟蹤狂園部夏穗。

[譯自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/11/01/november-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
